blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — It seems that the public will be seeing more project inspections from the heads of Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) and Department of Transportation, as DOTr Sec. Vince Dizon acknowledged the criticisms he got for doing so. As Dizon bids farewell to the DPWH and returns to DOTr, he said he and new DPWH chief Giovanni Lopez will conduct joint inspections in the coming weeks and months. “I think you will be seeing the two of us together jointly going around inspecting projects kasi marami akong ipapasa sa kanya, marami rin siyang ipapasa sa akin,” Dizon […]...
